claim: Digital displays overlay guidance on the real world.
originalWording: Digital displays overlay guidance on the real world.

sources.title: How My Predictions Are Faring — Ray Kurzweil
sources.locator: The Singularity Is Near predictions for 2010, prediction 7, printed p. 132

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Digital instructions or information overlay the user’s view of the physical world.
reference.rationale: Nomad’s deployed see-through repair guidance already provided the functional overlay before 2010. The availability claim is met; we do not require everyone to wear AR glasses.

evidence.title: Microvision: Nomad retinal display installed at Chevrolet dealership
evidence.note: Microvision-issued release hosted by The Auto Channel: actual industrial deployment.
